query: SELECT json_build_object('cd_offerings',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('level',level_name,'series',series_name,'subject',subject_name) ORDER BY series_name,subject_name) FROM (SELECT l.name AS level_name,sr.name AS series_name,s.name AS subject_name FROM public.course_subject_offerings o JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id JOIN public.subjects s ON s.id=o.subject_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('C','D') ORDER BY sr.name,s.name LIMIT 100) q),'cd_coefficients',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('C','D')),'preserved_a_coefficients',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_coefficients c JOIN public.course_subject_offerings o ON o.id=c.subject_offering_id JOIN public.levels l ON l.id=o.level_id JOIN public.series sr ON sr.id=o.series_id WHERE l.name='Terminale' AND sr.name IN ('A1','A2') AND c.is_verified),'grade_count',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.edutech_grades),'c_profiles',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE school_level='Terminale' AND series='C'),'d_profiles',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.profiles WHERE school_level='Terminale' AND series='D')) AS audit LIMIT 1;
